name: Void Stalker
desc: A vacuum-born predator that hunts by heat.

intro: Something long and pale unfolds from the dark, turning its eyeless head toward the heat of your body.
hit: Claws rake through your suit, and the cold comes in.
It hits you from a direction you weren't watching.
miss: It lashes out at where you were, and it's already gone again.
Claws screech across the hull beside your head.
crit: It gets its jaws around you and shakes.
defeated: The stalker curls in on itself, and its pale skin goes dark.
